purpose: Freeze a fail-closed local OpenAI-compatible answer transport with byte-exact image provenance and complete single-attempt accounting before any real Mem-Gallery request.

transport_contract.endpoint_scope: Only http://127.0.0.1:<1024-65535>/v1/chat/completions is accepted. The exact unused port is deferred to and must be frozen by the future lifecycle package.
transport_contract.network_scope: Loopback only; no DNS, remote host, HTTPS proxy, query parameters, fragments, or embedded credentials.
transport_contract.timeout: Must be a finite positive value and must be frozen by the numerical authorization before any real request.
transport_contract.response_rule: HTTP 200, one nonempty response id, exactly one textual nonempty choice, nonempty finish reason, and nonnegative prompt/completion/total token counts with exact addition.
transport_contract.failure_rule: Timeout, connection, HTTP, byte ceiling, JSON, schema, empty-answer, usage, or clock failure raises one terminal EndpointCallError containing a retained FAILED call record; the client never retries or substitutes a result.

image_contract.identity_scope: Only safe data/image/... POSIX identities already present in the frozen dataset manifest are accepted.
image_contract.root_scope: The dataset root must be absolute, existing, and not a symlink; every path component and final image must be non-symlink and resolve beneath it.
image_contract.byte_identity: The image bytes must match the manifest LFS SHA-256 before encoding.
image_contract.encoding: Standard base64 data URL in the same structured-content position as the abstract image_ref.
image_contract.request_identities: Record canonical SHA-256 both before image expansion and for the transmitted request.

call_record_contract: schema version and final_answer call category
status, HTTP status, response SHA-256 and response byte count
wall seconds, response id, finish reason
nonempty error type/error for terminal failure and null error fields for acceptance

covered_invariants: image path, manifest hash, MIME, base64 position, and byte ledger
image traversal, symlink, and hash-drift rejection
accepted response identity, usage, and elapsed-time accounting
one-attempt timeout and malformed-JSON failures with retry_count zero

next_gate: Build a fresh control-runner lifecycle package binding the accepted dataset identity, exact model inventory, exact loopback port, tokenizer, timeout, resource ceiling, raw-run schema, and a synthetic no-score endpoint. Do not contact the real Qwen service until that successor is frozen and accepted after Wave 1 releases resources.
authorization: This mock-only stage authorizes no real dataset read, image read, endpoint request, model service, prediction, retry, scoring, result admission, claim, SOTA language, or cleanup.
explicitly_prohibited: using a remote or mutable endpoint
sending an image not bound to the accepted dataset manifest
automatic or manual same-root retry after any endpoint failure
accepting absent, empty, malformed, multi-choice, or unaccounted responses
logging authorization credentials or treating mock transport tests as a reproduced result
